# Persona corpora — regenerated by `scripts/01_build_personas.py`

Persona markdown files (roughly 44,000 files across 27 configurations —
2,615 respondents × 11 ablations C0–C10 plus the 16 target-holdout variants
C6\*<outcome> used in Appendix G) are **not committed** to this repository
because of their bulk (~500 MB).

## How to regenerate

After preparing the TGSS derived CSV (see `../raw/README.md` and the pipeline
step `00_prepare_data.py`), run:

```bash
python scripts/01_build_personas.py
```

This will populate this folder with one subdirectory per configuration
(`C0/`, `C1/`, …, `C6star_pacvolunteer/`, `C6star_paccontact/`, …) and one
Markdown file per respondent (`TGSS_0001.md`, …, `TGSS_2615.md`).

The persona corpora are **deterministic** — given the same TGSS derived
CSV and the same `config/ablations.yaml`, byte-identical files are produced
on any machine. No API calls are made in this step.
